description: This file implements the task execution management system, including creation and control of various execution contexts such as single workers, worker pools, and prioritized multi-queue workers. It manages the lifecycle of executors and execution contexts, supporting different queue policies and configurations.

classes.name: common_task_execution_context
classes.description: Template class providing shared functionality for different worker types, managing executor creation, storage, and lifecycle.

classes.name: single_worker_context
classes.description: Specialized execution context for a single general task worker with configurable queue policies and wait strategies.

classes.name: worker_pool_context
classes.description: Execution context for a worker pool with a single queue, supporting creation of task worker pool executors.

classes.name: priority_worker_pool_context
classes.description: Execution context for a prioritized worker pool with multiple queues, supporting creation of prioritized task executors.

classes.name: priority_multiqueue_worker_context
classes.description: Execution context for a priority multi-queue worker, supporting creation of priority task executors.

methods.name: convert_to_qparams
methods.description: Converts a span of task queues into a vector of concurrent queue parameters.

methods.name: create_execution_context
methods.description: Factory functions to create various execution contexts based on configuration parameters.

methods.name: add_execution_context
methods.description: Adds a new execution context to the manager, including its executors, ensuring no duplicates.
